change.source: finding 3 (a bridge started before the service answers ends): the open at the start runs through the tries and pauses of the wake and prints the line of the wake under the name of the bridge once; a refusal that is no passing failure still ends the bridge (cases a_bridge_started_before_the_service_answers_waits_for_it and a_bridge_started_before_the_service_answers_says_so_and_keeps_trying; mutant m18 red)
